title: All course records
description: Selects all <course> elements under the root <courses> element

title: Names of all courses
description: Selects the <name> child element from each course

title: Courses with more than 50 students
description: Uses a predicate to filter courses where student count exceeds 50

description: Filters courses carrying exactly 4 credit hours

title: Theory courses only
description: Filters courses by the Theory type value

title: Theory courses with more than 50 students (names)

title: Faculty for courses with at least 4 credits
description: Returns faculty names where course credits are 4 or more

title: Course with ID C104
description: Selects a course by its unique attribute using @attribute-name syntax

title: First course
description: Selects the first course using positional predicate [1]

title: Last course
description: Selects the last course using the last() function
